paragraphs.text: UNESCO reported on 25 September 2026 that Mexican organisations had opened a meeting on community tourism, research and local networks. Participants included the National Fund for Tourism Development, the national science ministry and Rosario Castellanos National University. The meeting aimed to connect researchers with public authorities and people providing tourism services. Its focus was how knowledge could help communities shape tourism.
paragraphs.translationJa: UNESCOは2026年9月25日、メキシコの組織が地域主体の観光、研究、地域のネットワークを扱う会合を開いたと報告した。国家観光開発基金、科学を担当する省、ロサリオ・カステジャノス国立大学などが参加した。研究者、行政、観光サービスを担う人々を結び、知識を地域の観光づくりにどう生かすかを考える会合だった。

paragraphs.text: The government is supporting 53 research projects at 30 institutions. Thirty-three of those projects were represented at the meeting. These numbers refer to different things: the first describes all supported projects, while the second describes the projects taking part in this event. They do not indicate the number of visitors or prove that every project has already succeeded.
paragraphs.translationJa: 政府は30機関の53研究事業を支援している。そのうち33事業が会合に参加した。この二つの数字は対象が異なる。53は支援する事業全体、33は今回の会合に参加した事業だ。観光客数を示すものでも、すべての事業がすでに成功したことを証明するものでもない。

paragraphs.text: Some projects work with fishing communities, cooperatives and local producers. Others involve traditional cooks or people producing coffee and mezcal. The meeting also sought to strengthen a national research network. That network would bring together academic institutions, authorities and service providers. The aim is to make research useful outside universities and connect it with the choices communities face in daily life. New indicators will examine social and environmental effects.
paragraphs.translationJa: 漁業の地域、協同組合、地元の生産者と協働する事業もあれば、伝統料理の担い手やコーヒー、メスカルの生産者に関わる事業もある。会合では全国的な研究ネットワークの強化も目指した。大学などの研究機関、行政、サービス提供者を結び、研究を大学の外で役立て、地域が日々直面する選択とつなげる狙いだ。 新たな指標で社会と環境への影響を調べる予定だ。

paragraphs.text: A central question is what counts as a positive impact. In its April 2025 announcement, UNESCO stressed income, employment and local communities. Income matters, but it is not the only concern. The approach seeks to ensure that local communities benefit while maintaining their living heritage. It therefore asks more than how many people arrive or how much money visitors spend.
paragraphs.translationJa: 重要なのは、何を好ましい影響と捉えるかだ。UNESCOは2025年4月の発表で、収入、雇用、地域の人々を重視した。収入は重要だが、関心はそれだけではない。地域が生きた文化を維持しながら利益を受けられることを目指している。そのため来訪者数や消費額だけを問うわけではない。

paragraphs.text: The earlier partnership described a participatory approach. It starts by recognising local places and cultural identities, then supports training and the development of tourism products. Promotion and evaluation also form part of the process. Communities are intended to shape the activity, rather than simply host visitors. This policy background helps explain why the September meeting brought researchers and service providers together.
paragraphs.translationJa: 先行する提携では、住民参加を重視する方法が示された。地域の土地や文化の認識から始まり、研修と観光商品の開発を支援する。広報と評価も過程に含まれる。地域は単に来訪者を受け入れるだけでなく、活動づくりを担うことが想定されている。この政策上の背景を踏まえると、9月の会合で研究者とサービス提供者が集まった理由が分かる。

comprehension.question: How many research projects receive government support?

evidence.text: The government is supporting 53 research projects at 30 institutions.

comprehension.explanationJa: 本文中の根拠に基づいて判断します。

comprehension.question: What did the earlier UNESCO announcement emphasise?
choices: Income, employment and the interests of local communities.
Only the number of visitors arriving at universities.
Only the cost of transport used by foreign visitors.
Economic earnings without any community concerns.

evidence.text: In its April 2025 announcement, UNESCO stressed income, employment and local communities.

comprehension.explanationJa: 本文中の根拠に基づいて判断します。

comprehension.question: Why would higher visitor spending not settle the evaluation?
choices: Other effects on communities must also be considered.
The programme treats all tourist spending as harmful.
The meeting has already proved every project succeeds.
The indicators deliberately exclude all economic effects.

evidence.text: Income matters, but it is not the only concern.

comprehension.explanationJa: 収入は評価の一部だが、社会・文化・環境への影響も扱うため、消費額の増加だけで成功とは判断できない。
